Players Committee card image of [[Specter Of The Supreme Leader (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “Deploy on table. The Phantom Menace is canceled. You lose no Force to Kylo or Kylo's Lightsaber. if Kylo (or Kylo's Lightsaber) just lost, may place this Effect in Lost Pile to take that card into hand. (Immune to Alter.)”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual7-Dark/large/specterofthesupremeleader.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6d7b3a40f529171f7399cff382887d6260118998 6d7b3a4] (9 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.
